channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PT estimula Kassab a patrocinar candidato de centro em SP; entenda
item.description: PT leaders are urging Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, to sponsor a centrist candidate for the São Paulo gubernatorial race in 2026, aiming to force a runoff and prevent Tarcísio de Freitas from winning in the first round. Although Kassab has publicly backed Tarcísio, Haddad’s allies believe he may be resentful over being sidelined in the governor’s re-election slate, particularly after Felício Ramuth left the PSD for the MDB and Rodrigo Garcia, a Kassab rival, was brought into Tarcísio’s campaign.

item.title: A pergunta da semana que está na boca de todo mundo
item.description: The nomination of Jorge Messias, Attorney General of the Union, to the Supreme Federal Court hinges on Senate approval, with David Alcolumbre maintaining opposition despite no longer having an alternative candidate. The confirmation hearing will take place the day after tomorrow (Wednesday, 20), while STF ministers like Flávio Dino work against the nomination and Kassio Nunes Marques and André Mendonça support it. The uncertainty carries significant political weight, as the outcome will influence the ideological balance of the Court.

item.title: Novas regras, parcerias regionais e classe média: como Lula reforça Minha Casa, Minha Vida em sua vitrine eleitoral
item.description: The Lula government is strengthening the Minha Casa, Minha Vida program as a central pillar of its 2026 electoral strategy, highlighting robust results in home ownership access despite high household indebtedness. The initiative aims to consolidate support among the middle class and low-income families through new rules and regional partnerships, turning the program into a showcase of achievements from his third term.

item.title: Missão arrecadar: a estratégia do governo para alcançar o superávit das contas a partir de 2027
item.description: The government aims to sustain its revenue-raising efforts starting in 2027, should President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva be re-elected, focusing on reducing tax exemptions ('tax expenditures') and increasing the progressivity of the tax system—meaning higher contributions from the wealthy. The strategy seeks to achieve a fiscal surplus from that year onward, despite previous measures already implemented. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Geopolítica e economia verde marcam presença do Brasil na feira industrial Hannover Messe 2026, na Alemanha
item.description: Brazil stood out at Hannover Messe 2026 with 800 business representatives from 300 companies, reinforcing its image as a stable and open partner in the global energy transition, particularly in biofuels and strategic minerals. President Lula’s meeting with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz underscored political alignment as a commercial advantage, even as he criticized EU regulations that could hinder Brazilian biofuel exports.

item.title: Em meio a pressão de Carlos, governadores bolsonaristas demonstram pouco engajamento nas redes à pré-campanha de Flávio
item.description: Bolsonarist governors have shown low engagement on social media in support of Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-candidacy, despite public pressure from his brother Carlos Bolsonaro for greater mobilization. Only Santa Catarina's governor, Jorginho Mello, has made explicit posts in Flávio's favor, though limited to three since January. Others, including Tarcísio de Freitas, Celina Leão, Ibaneis Rocha, and Wilson Lima, have made minimal or no mentions of Flávio on their official accounts.

item.title: Apoios a Lula e caso Master: entenda por que o PT suavizou tom de manifesto aprovado durante congresso nacional
item.description: The PT approved a manifesto during its national congress in Brasília, aiming to strengthen support for the re-election of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The document proposes judicial and political reforms, including changes to parliamentary amendments, and seeks dialogue with centrist parties through a 'social concertation'.

item.title: 59% dos brasileiros dizem que renda é insuficiente
item.description: A Datafolha survey from April 2026 shows that 59% of Brazilians say their household income is insufficient to cover expenses, 36% say it is exactly what they need, and 6% say it is more than enough. The survey also found that 45% sought to supplement their income recently, with higher rates among the more educated, and that 4 in 10 respondents reported a reduction in family income over the past months, particularly among those aged 35 to 44.

item.title: Dosimetria volta ao Congresso nesta semana com iminente derrota do Planalto
item.description: Brazil's National Congress will convene in its first joint session of 2026 this Thursday (April 30) to decide whether to override President Lula's veto on the dosimetry bill, which seeks to reduce sentences for those convicted in the January 8 attacks. Approved in late 2025 during a low point in Lula-Legislature relations, the bill could reduce former President Jair Bolsonaro's 27-year-and-3-month sentence for leading a coup plot after the 2022 election to approximately two years in closed regime. The opposition, holding a majority in the Chamber, aims to overturn the veto with over 300 votes, while Lula's allies anticipate defeat amid mounting political pressure ahead of the 2026 general elections.

item.title: Veja medidas do pacote contra endividamento previsto para 1º de maio
item.description: The Lula government is preparing a package of measures to reduce household debt in Brazil, with an announcement expected on May 1st. The plan includes reformulating the Desenrola Brasil program with broader discounts on bank and non-bank debts, using public guarantees via the FGO to lower interest rates, and analyzing the use of FGTS funds to help workers pay off high-cost debts.

item.title: Em busca de bandeira para Lula na segurança, governo mira em integração com estados em nova fase de programa de combate a roubo de celular
item.description: The Lula government is preparing a new phase of the national program to combat cellphone theft, focusing on integrating data from police reports, IMEIs, and state security systems, inspired by Piauí’s experience. The initiative aims to improve identification, blocking, and return of stolen devices, including notifications for buyers of stolen phones, as part of a strategy to boost the president’s popularity amid high public concern over this crime.

item.title: Desafio do lulismo é oferecer não só inclusão, mas também perspectiva
item.description: The recent decline in Lula’s popularity reflects a deeper disconnect between the inclusive social rhetoric of lulism and a society marked by precarity, debt, and new aspirations. The article argues that the challenge for the government goes beyond communication or economic performance, requiring a new vision that engages with Brazil’s structural transformations.

item.title: Motta escolhe nesta semana relator da PEC do fim da escala 6x1
item.description: Chamber of Deputies President Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB) will choose this week the rapporteur for the PEC proposing the end of the 6x1 work scale, following negotiations among party leaders. Deputy Paulo Azi (União Brasil-BA), who served as rapporteur in the Constitution and Justice Committee, is a leading candidate, while Solidarity Party leader Paulinho da Força was also mentioned. The appointment will coincide with the installation of a special committee to analyze the proposal, which aims to reduce the weekly workweek to 40 hours or adopt a 5x2 scale — a key electoral issue for President Lula’s government.

item.title: Zema sugere que Gilmar parece personagem de “A Praça é Nossa”
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) shared on his X profile a clip from an interview on Rádio Cultura de Catalão where, upon hearing Minister Gilmar Mendes, he compared him to Deputy João Plenário from the comedy show 'A Praça é Nossa'. The comment referenced the minister's speech being hard to understand, a point Zema had previously addressed in his AI-generated series 'Os Intocáveis'. Zema and Mendes have exchanged public criticisms in recent weeks, including over speech style and use of private jets.

item.title: Bolsonaro cumpre pena em casa com piscina e de tornozeleira; veja infográfico
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro, sentenced to 27 years and three months for attempted coup, is serving house arrest in a luxury home with a pool and garden in Solar de Brasília, having left the Papudinha prison cell. The infographic highlights the contrast between his former incarceration and current residence in Brasília’s upscale Jardim Botânico neighborhood.

item.title: Bolsonaro completa um mês em casa com filmes, cachorros e Michelle confinada em rotina de cuidados
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro completes one month of house arrest at his Brasília residence, spending time watching TV and moderately interacting with his dogs. Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro oversees his care, having withdrawn from public and political life.

item.title: PT produz vídeo para tentar vincular Flávio Bolsonaro ao caso Master
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) released a video attempting to link Flávio Bolsonaro to the Master Bank scandal, claiming he received a R$6 million mansion as part of a so-called 'bolsomaster' scheme. However, Bolsonaro is not under investigation in the case, and the mansion was purchased in 2021 via BRB financing, prior to the bank’s 2024–2025 involvement with Master. The video was circulated during the PT’s 8th National Congress in Brasília, reflecting a mutual blame game between PT and Bolsonaro supporters over the scandal’s origins.

item.title: Fernando Schüler estreia série de encontros sobre futuro do Brasil no Teatro Iguatemi
item.description: Political scientist Fernando Schüler launches the 'Contemporary Brazil' series of talks at Teatro Iguatemi, with the first debate scheduled for April 27 at 8 PM, featuring former state deputy Heni Ozi Cukier. The initiative aims to analyze the challenges and prospects of contemporary Brazil.

item.title: Erika Hilton acusa Tarcísio de favorecer bolsonaristas em ato na Paulista
item.description: Deputy Erika Hilton (Psol-SP) accused Governor Tarcísio de Freitas of attempting to prevent workers from holding a demonstration on Paulista Avenue on May 1st, Labor Day, to demand the end of the 6×1 work schedule. She claimed the governor was favoring Bolsonaristas by restricting the right to strike and protest.

item.title: Violência política de esquerda cresceu na era Trump e deixa uma lição para o Brasil
item.description: The content analyzes the rise of left-wing political violence in the U.S. during the Trump era, citing CSIS data showing that, in the first half of 2025, leftist attacks surpassed right-wing ones for the first time, though they are generally less lethal. Despite Trump avoiding labeling the recent shooter as 'radical left,' the pattern of hostility toward him persists. The text offers a lesson for Brazil about the dangers of polarization and the legitimization of political violence, regardless of ideological spectrum.

item.title: PT aprova manifesto sem citar escândalo do Banco Master
item.description: The Workers' Party approved its 2026 electoral manifesto following adjustments requested by the Presidential Palace. The final version removed direct references to former President Jair Bolsonaro and the Banco Master scandal, softening the original criticism. The document retains the party's political guidelines for the election year, emphasizing unity and campaign strategy.

item.title: Moraes concede prisão domiciliar a 18 idosos do 8 de Janeiro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes granted humanitarian house arrest to 18 elderly individuals convicted for the January 8 attacks, all aged between 60 and 73 and suffering from serious illnesses. The ruling comes six days before Congress votes on the presidential veto of the Dosimetry Bill and includes electronic ankle monitoring, bans on social media, international travel, and unauthorized visits.

item.title: PT lança diretrizes que governo do PT não foi capaz de entregar
item.description: The PT approved three documents at its Congress: a manifesto aimed at softening an electoral tactic and the guidelines for a potential fourth Lula term. The texts reveal plans that the current PT government failed to deliver, highlighting a gap between party proposals and governmental achievements. This suggests the party is attempting to reposition itself amid criticism over poor implementation.

item.title: PT fala em ser “antissistema” e quer colar Bolsonaro à velha política
item.description: At its 8th National Congress in April 2026, the PT reclaimed the 'anti-system' discourse to reposition itself as an alternative to the current political model, advocating for electoral, judicial, and economic reforms while criticizing the PL and fascism as representatives of the old politics. PT president Edinho Silva stated that the response to public outrage for change lies on the left and that the Lula government embodies this anti-system stance, seeking to distance the party from recent scandals such as the Banco Master case.

item.title: Ministros do STF estão preocupados com investigações que miram Lulinha
item.description: STF ministers are concerned that investigations targeting Lulinha, President Lula’s son, may have been influenced by allies of Justice André Mendonça, suspecting ideological bias and an attempt to revive the spirit of Operation Car Wash. Despite lacking concrete evidence, the ministers claim Lula was already informed of the alleged conspiracy, citing the presence of a Federal Police delegate in Mendonça’s office as indicative. The bank and tax data breaches ordered by Mendonça in January were annulled by Justice Flávio Dino on constitutional grounds.

item.title: Zema volta a ironizar ministros do STF em vídeo após pedido de Gilmar sobre inquérito das fake News
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and presidential pre-candidate for the Novo party, again mocked STF justices in a video from the 'Intocáveis' series after Gilmar Mendes requested his inclusion in the fake news investigation. The video, featuring AI-generated portrayals, depicts Mendes and Alexandre de Moraes as puppets, reigniting tensions between the politician and the Court. Mendes had previously apologized for referencing homosexuality in his criticism of Zema.

item.title: O famigerado liberalismo atacado pelo manifesto do PT melhorou espetacularmente as condições sociais
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) softened its manifesto to appeal to centrist voters, removing criticisms of the Central Bank and the middle class, resulting in a bland text. Nevertheless, the PT retained its identity by attacking neoliberalism as the cause of Brazil's social problems, a stance that distinguishes it from other parties seen as amoebic and opportunistic. The author, however, argues this critique is historically mistaken, claiming liberalism dramatically improved global living conditions over the past 200 years, citing rising life expectancy and falling infant mortality as evidence.

item.title: Governo vai desarmar bombas da gestão Haddad que tiram popularidade de Lula
item.description: The Lula government will reverse unpopular economic measures from Haddad's administration, including the 20% tax on international purchases under US$50 ('blusinhas tax') and betting regulation, to regain popularity. Lula will also campaign on ending the 6×1 workweek, with support from Hugo Motta, though the issue remains stalled in Congress, serving more as electoral rhetoric than concrete action.

item.title: Por que o STF ‘dobra a aposta’?
item.description: Despite mounting criticism, the Brazilian Supreme Court (STF) is expanding its assertive actions, such as broadening investigations and including new political figures in inquiries, because the country's extreme political fragmentation and high coordination costs make institutional retaliation unlikely. Ministers perceive that the practical risk of effective backlash is low, allowing them to 'double down' on their positions. This behavior reflects a strategic calculation: while rhetoric may be heated, the institutional cost of challenging the STF outweighs any potential gain for other branches in the short term.

item.title: Erika Hilton diz que Tarcísio vetou Paulista para ato contra 6 X 1
item.description: Deputy Erika Hilton (Psol-SP) accused Governor Tarcísio de Freitas of blocking a workers’ rally on Avenida Paulista on May 1st, which aimed to end the 6x1 work schedule, claiming the venue was reserved for Bolsonarist groups. She argued the move seeks to weaken labor struggles and amplify pro-Bolsonaro narratives. The workers’ event was relocated to Praça Roosevelt.

item.title: Alckmin anuncia programa de juros reduzidos para máquinas agrícolas em feira do setor
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin announced at Agrishow a new financing program with reduced interest rates for agricultural machinery, allocating R$ 10 billion via Finep/FNDCT and expecting single-digit interest rates. He also referenced the "Brazil Sovereign" plan (R$ 15 billion via BNDES) and said the government is preparing measures for delinquent producers. Alckmin aims to rapprochen the government with the agribusiness sector, traditionally critical of the PT and aligned with opposition figures like Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado.

item.title: Em vídeo, Zema promete privatizar Petrobras e Banco do Brasil
item.description: Romeu Zema, pre-candidate for President from the Novo Party, promised in a video posted on social media to privatize Petrobras and Banco do Brasil if elected, claiming these state-owned enterprises 'generate losses'. He also said he aims to cut public spending, eliminate privileges, and slash 'supersalaries'.

item.title: Lula retorna a Brasília após dois procedimentos médicos em São Paulo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva returned to Brasília on Sunday (April 26) after undergoing two medical procedures in São Paulo: removal of a scalp keratosis and an infiltration to treat tendinitis. Both procedures were successful with no complications, and he was discharged the same day of hospitalization. Lula will face no restrictions and will carry out government duties remotely on Monday, including announcing investments in the dairy chain and inaugurating a radiotherapy center in São Paulo.

item.title: Lula enviou mensagem de solidariedade ao presidente Trump, diz Alckmin
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin highlighted that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva sent a message of solidarity to U.S. President Donald Trump following a shooting at a White House Correspondents' Association gala in Washington, condemning political violence. Alckmin also stated that renegotiation of rural debt for Brazilian farmers is underway, involving R$ 81.693 billion in eligible credit operations, with proposals from the Finance Ministry and Senator Renan Calheiros to be aligned by Tuesday.

item.title: Zema promete privatizar Petrobras e Banco do Brasil se for eleito
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) announced that if elected president in 2026, he plans to privatize Petrobras and Banco do Brasil to reduce public debt, cut spending, and eradicate corruption. In an Instagram video, he criticized President Lula’s administration for overspending and relying on loans, arguing that fiscal discipline—not borrowing—is the solution. Zema summarized his platform as 'privatize, save, don’t steal, prosper'.

item.title: PT apresenta prévia de ataque a Flávio com foco em Master e corrupção. Vídeo
item.description: At the 8th National Congress of the Workers' Party (PT) in Brasília, the party unveiled a preview of its electoral attack against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, linking him to the Banco Master scandal and alleging corruption throughout his political career. The videos claim Flávio benefited from donations by relatives of Banco Master executives, purchased real estate with cash, and employed militia-linked staff in his office, concluding he is 'the most corrupt son of Bolsonaro'.

item.title: Lula volta a Brasília após dois procedimentos de saúde em São Paulo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva returned to Brasília after undergoing two medical procedures in São Paulo: removal of a basal cell carcinoma on his head and an injection to treat tendinitis in his right thumb. According to Secom, he is now at the Palácio da Alvorada with no public engagements this Sunday, and is expected to resume activities in two days, requiring only the precaution of wearing a hat due to the skin lesion.

item.title: Lula retorna a Brasília após passar por procedimentos em São Paulo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva returned to Brasília after undergoing two medical procedures in São Paulo: removal of a skin cancer lesion (basal cell carcinoma) from his scalp and an infiltration in the wrist to treat tendinitis in his right thumb. The procedures were performed at the Syrian-Lebanese Hospital without complications, and he was discharged the same day. Medical advice recommends rest over the weekend and resumption of normal activities on Monday, with extra precautions against sun exposure.

item.title: Na Agrishow, Alckmin anuncia R$ 10 bi de financiamento para maquinário
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) announced a R$10 billion financing package for agricultural machinery during the opening of Agrishow in Ribeirão Preto. The funds, sourced from the surplus of the National Fund for Scientific and Technological Development and managed by Finep, will be available in 20 to 30 days with low interest rates to modernize farming equipment. The government also announced plans to advance debt renegotiation for the agribusiness sector, covering both delinquent and current payers.

item.title: Temos 4 ex-ministros disponíveis para a chapa em SP, diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad stated that four former ministers from Lula’s government — himself, Simone Tebet, Marina Silva, and Márcio França — are available to join the majoritarian ticket in São Paulo, with Tebet seen as the best choice for vice-governor. Senate nominations remain open, with França and Marina as leading contenders, while Tarcísio de Freitas leads in polls for the gubernatorial race.

item.title: Veja as escalações de Corinthians e Vasco para o jogo do Brasileirão
item.description: Corinthians and Vasco da Gama have released their starting lineups for the 13th round of the Brasileirão, set for this Sunday at 4 p.m. Corinthians fielded Kauê, Raniele, Gustavo Henrique, Gabriel Paulista, Matheus Bidu, Allan, André Luiz, Rodrigo Garro, Breno Bidon, Vitinho, and Yuri Alberto. Vasco opted for Léo Jardim, Paulo Henrique, Alan Saldivia, Robert Renan, Cuiabano, Thiago Mendes, Cauan Barros, Tchê Tchê, Andrés Gomez, Brenner, and David. Both teams come into the match off recent victories in the Copa do Brasil.

item.title: PT aprova manifesto com diretrizes para eleições 2026, afasta polêmicas e faz aceno ao centro
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) approved its manifesto for the 2026 elections, focusing on comparing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's administration with that of Jair Bolsonaro, aiming to highlight achievements of the current government and outline a plan for a potential fourth term. The document avoided controversies and made an overture to the political center to broaden its support base.

item.title: Sem Lula, congresso do PT mira 'bolsonarinho' e reconquista da periferia
item.description: At the 8th PT Congress, without President Lula's presence, party leaders mocked Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, calling him 'bolsonarinho', while PT president Edinho Silva urged the party to reconnect with peripheral voters.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro condena ataque a tiros em jantar com Trump
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) expressed solidarity with U.S. President Donald Trump following a shooting attack that interrupted a dinner in Washington on Saturday night, the 25th. In a post on X, the lawmaker stated that he placed Trump, First Lady Melania Trump, and all those present in his prayers.

item.title: Presidente do PT diz que partido precisa ter 'humildade' para se aproximar de evangélicos e motoristas de app
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva urged the party to show humility in approaching evangelical youth and app-based workers, acknowledging their resistance and the need to understand their reasons. He criticized the party's reactive and withdrawn stance amid electoral losses and anti-system sentiment, arguing that the response to anti-system sentiment lies on the left, not the right. The remarks were made at the closing of the PT's 8th National Congress, where a manifesto was approved aiming to reelect Lula through social concertation and grassroots presence.

item.title: Haddad chama Flávio de "Bolsonarinho" e contesta discurso de senador
item.description: Fernando Haddad, pre-candidate for São Paulo governor and former finance minister, called Flávio Bolsonaro 'Bolsonarinho' during the PT's 8th National Congress, criticizing the Bolsonaro family for delivering 'chaos' to the country and accusing them of practicing the 'worst politics' for 30 years. Haddad stressed that Lula's re-election is imperative and that there is no alternative to bolsonarist regression.

item.title: PT aprova manifesto sem citar escândalos Master e INSS e partido fala em atrair apoio do centro
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) approved its 2026 electoral manifesto, streamlined at the request of the Planalto Palace, which removed over ten direct references to Bolsonaro and omitted mentions of the Banco Master scandal and INSS fraud. The document retains the party’s three central development axes, contrasts Lula’s governance with the previous administration without naming the former president, and was unanimously adopted at the party congress.

item.title: Lula que replicar fórmula do ‘pré-sal’ na exploração de terras raras
item.description: The Lula government is planning to replicate the pre-salt model for the exploration of critical minerals, such as rare earths, with a report being prepared by Arnaldo Jardim. The goal is to determine who will assume the role of priority explorer, similar to Petrobras in the pre-salt, although the government has denied creating a new state-owned entity for this purpose. Recently, U.S.-based USA Rare Earth acquired Serra Verde, Brazil’s only industrial rare earths plant, for $2.8 billion, raising concerns about national sovereignty over strategic resources.

item.title: Haddad chama Flávio de 'Bolsonarinho' e contesta discurso antissistema de senador
item.description: Haddad criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, calling him 'Bolsonarinho' and stating that the Bolsonaro family presents itself as anti-system but has implemented the worst policies in the country for 30 years. He also stressed that Lula's re-election is an imperative for the PT and for Brazil.

item.title: Bolsonaros fazem pior política da história do país, diz Haddad
item.description: Former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad (PT) accused the Bolsonaro family of implementing the worst policies in Brazil's history over 30 years, despite posing as anti-system. He stated that the PT cannot allow a setback in the 2026 elections and that Lula will run against Flávio Bolsonaro, whom he referred to as 'Bolsonarinho'. Haddad positioned the PT as the antidote to chaos and announced the approval of the party's new manifesto at the 8th National Congress in Brasília.
